description: Zheng, Fanning and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The implemented energy-management formulation optimizes day-ahead and intra-day participation while accounting for load-dependent costs. Short-term generation and price forecasts are combined with a wake-aware plant flow model and active-power tracking. The source also quantifies achievable synthetic inertia under operational constraints. Reported improvements arise from simulation; the abstract does not identify a deployed trading controller or public site data. This formulation is distinct from lifetime-budget control and the separately described inertia-forecasting model. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
